resources.title: European Framework for the Digital Competence of Educators: DigCompEdu
resources.title_zh: 欧洲教育工作者数字能力框架 DigCompEdu
resources.license: Reuse subject to the European Commission legal notice; verify at source
resources.summary_en: A six-area reference framework for reflecting on educators' digital practice. Use the progression descriptions to identify observable examples rather than treating it as a complete performance score.
resources.summary_zh: 一个包含六个领域的教育者数字实践参考框架。可用进阶描述寻找可观察实例，但不应直接当作完整表现分数。

resources.title: DigCompEdu self-reflection tools and CheckIn Higher Education
resources.title_zh: DigCompEdu 自我反思工具与高校 CheckIn
resources.license: Access and reuse subject to source terms
resources.summary_en: A higher-education self-reflection instrument. Its value here is goal clarification and evidence prompts; self-ratings are not substituted for an evidence-based assessment.
resources.summary_zh: 面向高校的自我反思工具。在本系统中用于澄清目标和提示证据，不用自评分替代基于证据的评价。

resources.title: AI Competency Framework for Teachers
resources.title_zh: 联合国教科文组织教师人工智能能力框架
resources.license: UNESCO open-access publication; verify document terms
resources.summary_en: Organizes teacher AI competence across five aspects and three progression levels, with a human-centred and ethical orientation.
resources.summary_zh: 从五个方面和三个进阶层级组织教师 AI 能力，强调以人为本和伦理取向。

resources.title: Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
resources.title_zh: 人工智能伦理问题建议书
resources.license: UNESCO open-access publication; verify document terms
resources.summary_en: A normative reference for examining AI-related human rights, privacy, fairness, transparency and accountability risks.
resources.summary_zh: 用于审视 AI 相关人权、隐私、公平、透明与问责风险的规范性参考。

resources.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework Playbook
resources.title_zh: NIST 人工智能风险管理框架实践手册
resources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
resources.license: US government work; verify third-party material terms
resources.summary_en: Action-oriented suggestions for governing, mapping, measuring and managing AI risks. Adapt the practices to the scale of a teaching or research workflow.
resources.summary_zh: 提供治理、识别、测量和管理 AI 风险的行动建议，可按教学或科研流程的规模进行适配。

resources.title: Design & Teach a Course
resources.summary_en: A practical sequence for specifying objectives, selecting assessment and choosing instructional strategies. It can support a small alignment audit of an existing course.
resources.summary_zh: 围绕目标、评价和教学策略提供实用流程，可用于对现有课程开展小规模对齐审查。

resources.title: Universal Design for Learning Guidelines 3.0
resources.license: Check CAST terms and attribution requirements
resources.summary_en: Design considerations for reducing barriers and supporting learner agency. Use one guideline to audit a real activity rather than attempting every checkpoint at once.
resources.summary_zh: 用于减少学习障碍并支持学习者主体性的设计参考。适合选择一个指南审查真实活动，而不是一次覆盖全部检查点。

resources.title: EQUATOR Network: Reporting guidelines and toolkits
resources.title_zh: EQUATOR 研究报告规范与工具
resources.license: Individual guideline terms vary; verify at source
resources.summary_en: A searchable collection of reporting guidelines. Selecting the guideline that matches a study design can reveal missing rationale or reporting evidence.
resources.summary_zh: 可检索的研究报告规范集合。选择与研究设计相匹配的规范，可用于发现缺失的设计理由或报告证据。

resources.title: COPE Core Practices
resources.title_zh: COPE 出版伦理核心实践
resources.summary_en: Concise practice areas for publication ethics, including authorship, data, conflicts and ethical oversight.
resources.summary_zh: 涵盖作者署名、数据、利益冲突和伦理监督等出版伦理核心实践。

resources.title: Data Carpentry lessons
resources.title_zh: Data Carpentry 数据技能课程
resources.license: CC BY (version may vary by lesson; verify at source)
resources.summary_en: Hands-on lessons for organizing, cleaning and analysing data. Choose a lesson that matches the teacher's discipline and tool constraints.
resources.summary_zh: 关于数据组织、清理和分析的实践课程，应按教师学科和工具条件选择合适内容。

resources.title: Open Science Framework guides
resources.title_zh: 开放科学框架 OSF 使用指南
resources.summary_en: Operational guidance for structuring, versioning, registering and sharing research projects with collaborators.
resources.summary_zh: 用于组织、版本管理、注册和协作分享科研项目的操作指南。

resources.title: W3C Web Accessibility Initiative: Planning and teaching resources
resources.title_zh: W3C Web 无障碍规划与教学资源
resources.license: W3C document license; verify at source
resources.summary_en: Planning, teaching and evaluation resources for introducing accessibility and checking digital content against user needs.
resources.summary_zh: 用于引入无障碍理念，并依据用户需要检查数字内容的规划、教学与评价资源。
